answer: Tiered standing keeps fake identities out of paid work. Each identity posts a 40-credit bond at tier zero, where rewards are capped; climbing needs five verified tasks, each receipt matched in a mirror check against the client's own record. The k-th fake still needs its own 40-credit bond and five fresh tasks, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 credits plus 5,000 tasks, with no reuse across identities. A falcon patrol checks climbs, and a fake that fails a check forfeits its bond. One honest agent posts one bond, climbs its own work history vine, and keeps its full share.
